categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four business segments: communication power supplies, new energy power supplies, industrial control power supplies, and other power supplies. Communication power supplies include products for telecom base stations, servers, and network equipment. New energy power supplies cover vehicle-mounted power supplies for new energy vehicles and charging piles. Industrial control power supplies serve automation and control equipment. Other power supplies include modular power supplies, photovoltaic/storage power supplies, special power supplies, laser power supplies, and rail transit power supplies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies in power electronics conversion, software control, and structural processes. It employs digital signal processing (DSP) for digitalized design, uses advanced topologies like synchronous rectification, LLC resonant converters, and high-density power modules. Production combines in-house manufacturing for complex processes and outsourced SMT and plug-in assembly. The company emphasizes customized design to meet specific customer requirements and complies with global safety certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international telecom equipment manufacturers such as Huawei, H3C, Ruijie Networks, Ericsson, Nokia, and ZTE. In new energy, customers are leading new energy vehicle integrators and OEMs like Changan Kuayue, Feidie Auto, CRRC Commercial Vehicle Power, Yutong, and King Long. Industrial control customers include global industrial connection solution providers like Weidmüller. The company serves telecom, new energy vehicles, industrial automation, data centers, and emerging digital economy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China, with domestic sales accounting for about 85% of revenue and overseas sales about 15%. It has facilities and subsidiaries in Shenzhen, Luoyang, and the Shenzhen-Shan Special Cooperation Zone. The company is expanding its product offerings to meet international standards and actively explores overseas markets, especially for charging piles and server power supplies.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the power supply industry, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of customized power modules and systems. It supplies critical power components and modules to equipment manufacturers and system integrators, acting as a key supplier in the telecom, new energy vehicle, and industrial control equipment supply chains.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on communication power supplies as its core business while expanding new energy and industrial control power supplies. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 12% of revenue spent on research, developing high-efficiency, high-density, and digitalized power solutions. Key R&D directions include server power supplies, high-power density DC/DC converters, bidirectional chargers, hydrogen fuel cell converters, and advanced charging pile technologies. The company also pursues product standardization and domestic substitution to reduce reliance on imports.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized power supply products and technical development services. The company employs a direct sales model, including vendor-managed inventory (VMI) arrangements with key customers. Revenue streams include product sales in communication, new energy, industrial control, and other power supply segments, as well as technical service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major domestic and international power supply manufacturers in telecom, new energy, and industrial control sectors. It holds a strong market position in customized power supplies with a focus on domestic telecom equipment makers and new energy vehicle integrators. The company leverages its proprietary technology platforms and high R&D investment to maintain competitive advantages and pursue market share in server power supplies and charging infrastructure.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 830 million, a 29.87% decline from 2023, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 89 million. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.67 billion and equity of RMB 1.33 billion. Despite recent financial challenges and a net loss, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D and expand its product portfolio. The company’s revenue is mainly domestic, with a smaller but growing international presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes customized power supply solutions with high efficiency (up to 97%) and compliance with global safety standards, including 80Plus Titanium certification for server power supplies. Its core value lies in proprietary technology platforms integrating power electronics, software control, and structural design, enabling high power density, digitalization, and reliability. The company’s products support critical infrastructure in telecom, new energy vehicles, and industrial automation, offering tailored solutions that meet diverse customer needs and promote domestic substitution of imported components.
